title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 8

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the platform be unavailable?
tasks.audioText: The college learning platform will be unavailable for maintenance on Saturday from eight until ten in the morning. Students should download any materials they need before Friday evening. Submitted work will remain saved, but online quizzes cannot be opened during the maintenance period. If the service is still unavailable after ten, contact the IT help desk.
options: On Saturday from eight to ten
On Saturday from ten to twelve
On Friday from eight to ten
On Sunday from eight to ten

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What should students do before Friday evening?
tasks.audioText: The college learning platform will be unavailable for maintenance on Saturday from eight until ten in the morning. Students should download any materials they need before Friday evening. Submitted work will remain saved, but online quizzes cannot be opened during the maintenance period. If the service is still unavailable after ten, contact the IT help desk.
options: Ask the tutor to email the materials after the maintenance
Download the materials they need
Wait until the platform is available again
Print the materials after Friday evening

tasks.prompt: Artem uses a digital folder to organise notes from his electronics course. He names each file with the subject and date, then stores diagrams separately from written summaries. Before a test, he searches the folder for key terms and checks that the latest version of each document is available. This system helps him avoid losing important information. Reading 1. How does Artem organise his files?
options: He sorts files only by file size
He saves diagrams and summaries in one document
He labels files by subject and date and separates diagrams from summaries
He organises files by the date they were downloaded.

tasks.prompt: Why does he check document versions?
options: To free space on his computer
To share every document with classmates
To make sure he uses the latest document
To make it easier to delete old course notes.

tasks.prompt: You ___ save your work before closing the programme.
options: should
should to
mustn't to
are

tasks.prompt: Choose TWO safe digital study practices.
options: Share your login details
Open unknown attachments
Use a clear file name
Keep a backup copy

tasks.prompt: A copy of a file kept in case the original is lost is a ___.
You cannot open a course file. What should you write to the IT desk?
options: Your system is useless.
Could you help me access the course file, please?
Fix it immediately or else.
I will send my password.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of digital learning in a sensible order.
options: Check its date and version
Open the course folder
Save a working copy
Find the required document

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words explaining how you organise digital study materials and protect important files.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains how digital study materials are organised and named or grouped (0–2); it describes sensible protection measures such as backups, access control or careful sharing (0–2); instructions are clear with understandable grammar (0–2); digital-study vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
